verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a hosted integration platform like Metorial, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a bulk export of user data (sessions, traces, logs, configs) in open formats. The nearest evidence is adjacent rather than the capability itself: a key-gated REST API that a developer could use to build an export, a source-available FSL license, and in-dashboard trace review.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
